body:
I have seen this in another package recently:
~~~
install(...
    INCLUDES DESTINATION "${concurrencpp_include_directory}"
    COMPONENT concurrencpp_Development
...
~~~~
COMPONENT can't be used after INCLUDES (as nothing is installed, only added to target properties).
https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/command/install.html#targets

Maybe another case for post-build checks.
@dg0yt Does this mean that an issue should be opened upstream with concurrencpp?

issue.title: Improper use of COMPONENT after INCLUDES in install

issue.body:
This caused the problem seen in issue https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/issues/32035.

The fix seems to be the removal of the COMPONENT option.
